SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This is my own decision.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's something that I've decided to finish, with my spirit, belief and pride on the line.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So please, speak no further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...But you know, isn't this slightly different since people are worried about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Imagine collapsing and getting sent to a hospital. Kirino, Saori and the members of the club would be worried sick about you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you aren't careful, the club activities could very well be suspended because of that too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...And? Haven't I told you before? I'm not obliged to listen to your words.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You're like a little sister to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it natural for me, a brother, to take care of you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino has said this before. You're an untamed cat, so it's necessary to be overbearing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh, that's something a girl who doesn't know anything would say...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And what of it? Isn't it better for you to back off before you get scratched?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] True, it did hurt. Being scratched by you the last time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's right. You're too bothersome, so I had to bare my claws.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, despite all that pain...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It puts me a million times more at ease than seeing you fall.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Wha-...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Compared to that, your claws are just a mere plaything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I've become tough! I won't be driven away by your claws!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's why I'll use any methods to stop you the next time you're being reckless again. I hope you're prepared!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Good grief... you are such a...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right. The thick-skinned mortals in this world live without any sense of shame...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I guess I won't be scratching you the next time, but biting you instead...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm quite happy if you would rather bite me. Your face will be closer to me, at least.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're really beyond all hope...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's fine to be worry about others, but how about considering your 【Own Future】 for a bit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then don't let me worry about you too much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But isn't that just you taking matters into your own hands?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I guess that's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's about it. That's all I want to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll be leaving then.
[FI] It's fine the way it is now. My worries won't be wasted as long as I'm able to help her a little.
[FI] If she's going to be reckless again, I'll stop her before she collapses.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...H-Hold on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] The... oracle just now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, what's wrong with you, Kuroneko? What oracle are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I would like to have a life counseling session.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Heh... Hahaha.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Stop laughing. I'm being serious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm being serious here as well. Life counseling, you say?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I never expected that from you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I've heard it long ago from her. She said it with a sense of pride too. I'm sure you'll listen to what I have to say if I were to put it this way, will you not?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So... could you listen to my troubles?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course, bring it on!
[FI] And with that, Kuroneko's life counseling session started.
[FI] I didn't really think the situation would develop this way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I've been drawing the event's manuscript, all by myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I just want to confirm how far I could go by my own right now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But it seems I can't finish by the deadline if this goes on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why... could you help me out?
[FI] This is my first time seeing such an honest and docile Kuroneko... I mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haha, isn't it the same as the suggestion I gave before?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Right. Just for now, I'll admit it. I was being stubborn before.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Is it all right like this? ...And? Will you accept?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course I will.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Since you've put it that way, I'll help you no matter what.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I see... Then starting from tomorrow, I'll be counting on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, please do.
[FI] Good grief, we have made a very big detour... However, this detour... seems to have some merit?
